_doc: Global balance numbers of this planet that belong to no single table. surge (design spec section 8; rules in core/surge_rules.gd, state in systems/surge.gd): Lumi's own work charges her Bloom Core and a full core is released as a Surge. charge.units: units of waste Lumi must clear by hand for one full charge, one entry per district in play order (the last entry serves any later district); city 1 is set so the first Surge comes about 4 minutes in, the others are about 4 minutes of her hand rate there from the pacing targets and are refitted in the balance pass. charge.per_bale: share of a full charge for each bale she presses. charge.per_plant / charge.per_water: share for each seed she plants and each pour that reaches a plant. charge.min_fill_s: the fastest a core may fill, in seconds of work, however good her tools are, so a Surge stays a moment. Robots never charge it and nothing charges it while no work is done. unlock: stats that must reach their numbers before the Surge opens (robots_built: 1 = it arrives with the first robot, so the opening keeps its fitted pace); none = open from the start. duration_s: how long a Surge lasts. stats: what a Surge multiplies each of Lumi's stats by in the first district (scoop_rate = sweeps a second, pickup_count = waste a sweep lifts, scoop_width and scoop_reach = the sweep's size); her hand output is scoop_rate x pickup_count. power_per_district: each district after the first adds this share to every multiplier's part above 1. chest_pack: how fast the chest fills during a Surge against plain sweeping (1 = as fast; swept waste takes chest_pack / output of its volume there and keeps its cube value), so the burst is not spent walking to the bin. wave: the growth wave. from_district: the first district (place in play order, from 1) whose Surges push one; rings: rings of hexes round Lumi it reaches there; rings_per_district: rings added per district after that; water_s: seconds of water every plant in reach gets; stages: growth stages every plant in reach is pushed on by.
